assumptions.statement_zh: 控规条件（容积率、建筑密度、建筑高度、绿地率等开发强度指标）、道路红线、市政管线容量、土地权属和工程可行性边界均需由专业团队依据官方附件确认；本方案不声称任何未获官方支持的法定控制结论。
assumptions.statement_en: Regulatory controls (FAR, building coverage, height, green ratio, etc.), road redlines, municipal utility capacities, land ownership, and engineering feasibility must be confirmed by professional teams from official attachments; this submission claims no statutory control conclusions without official support.
assumptions.impact_zh: 本方案可在临时边界和已公开资料基础上完成 formal intake 与内容评分；涉及具体建设指标时只能给出概念建议和范围指引，不能替代法定控规。
assumptions.impact_en: The package can pass formal intake and content scoring on provisional boundaries and publicly available data. Specific construction metrics are provided as conceptual guidance only, not as a substitute for statutory regulatory plans.

assumptions.statement_zh: 总体设计范围（11.4 平方公里）和三处重点区域边界为临时粗略 polygon，由维护者依据公告文字四至和约面积在 EPSG:4548 下校核推算得出。所有设计图层均在此临时边界内生成。官方精确红线发布后，全部 geometry、metrics、面积复算、图纸和 HTML 均需重新计算。
assumptions.statement_en: The Overall Design Area (11.4 km²) and three Key Area boundaries are provisional rough polygons inferred by maintainers from textual boundary descriptions and approximate area constraints, checked in EPSG:4548. All design layers are generated within these provisional boundaries. When official precise polygons are released, all geometry, metrics, drawings, and HTML must be recomputed.

assumptions.statement_zh: site_area_sqm、key_area areas、green_ratio、public_space_ratio、building_footprint_area_sqm 等基于临时 boundary 计算得出。面积值与公告声明的约值（43.6 km² CRA、11.4 km² ODA、368.4 ha KDA、192.1/104.3/72.0 ha key areas）在校验范围内，但不精确。官方 boundary 替换后所有面积和比例需重算。
assumptions.statement_en: site_area_sqm, key_area areas, green_ratio, public_space_ratio, and building_footprint_area_sqm are computed from provisional boundaries. Calculated areas are within tolerance of announced approximate values (43.6 km² CRA, 11.4 km² ODA, 368.4 ha KDA, 192.1/104.3/72.0 ha key areas) but are not exact. All areas and ratios must be recomputed after official boundary replacement.

assumptions.statement_zh: 容积率（FAR）、建筑密度、建筑高度上限、绿地率下限等控规指标在公开资料中未找到确定值。本方案不提供具体 FAR 数值；如需指标约束，以官方控规文件为准。
assumptions.statement_en: FAR, building coverage ratio, building height limits, minimum green ratio, and other regulatory controls are not available in public sources. This submission does not provide specific FAR values; official regulatory plan documents govern when available.

assumptions.statement_zh: 市政管线容量、变电站负荷、污水处理能力等基础设施承载力数据未进入公开资料包。方案中的新型基础设施（AI 算力节点、感知网络）为概念布局，不替代市政工程可行性研究。
assumptions.statement_en: Municipal utility capacities (water, power, sewage, telecom) are not in the public site package. Proposed new infrastructure (AI compute nodes, sensor networks) are conceptual layouts and do not replace municipal engineering feasibility studies.

assumptions.statement_zh: 京张铁路遗址的具体文物保护范围、建设控制地带和保护要求需依据文物主管部门正式文件确认。方案中的铁路遗产活化策略为概念建议，不构成文物保护结论。
assumptions.statement_en: The precise heritage protection boundaries, construction control zones, and conservation requirements for the Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park must be confirmed from official cultural heritage authority documents. Proposed railway heritage activation strategies are conceptual suggestions, not heritage conservation conclusions.

assumptions.statement_zh: 方案中引用的 5-8 个全球 AI 生态/校准案例（如丰田 woven city、Sidewalk Toronto、巴塞罗那超级街区、首尔汉江公园、旧金山 Mission Rock、苏黎世 WestLink、新加坡 Jurong Innovation District、伦敦 Olympic Park legacy 等）为公开可查的背景参考资料，用于说明全球趋势和设计方向，不直接复制其设计或声称可比精确对标。
assumptions.statement_en: The 5-8 global AI ecosystem/calibration cases cited (Toyota Woven City, Sidewalk Toronto, Barcelona superblocks, Seoul Han River Park, San Francisco Mission Rock, Zurich WestLink, Singapore Jurong Innovation District, London Olympic Park legacy, etc.) are publicly available background references for global trends and design direction. They do not constitute precise comparable benchmarks.

assumptions.statement_zh: 10+ 场景卡中描述的具体技术方案、服务流程和部署规模为 AI agent 基于公开趋势和任务书要求生成的概念建议。具体技术选型、隐私合规边界、安全审计机制需专业团队在获取正式数据和许可后确认。
assumptions.statement_en: Specific technical solutions, service workflows, and deployment scales described in the 10+ scenario cards are AI agent-generated conceptual suggestions based on public trends and taskbook requirements. Technology selection, privacy compliance boundaries, and security audit mechanisms require professional confirmation with formal data and permits.

assumptions.statement_zh: 官方 boundary 替换触发条件为：征集组织机构发布可验证坐标系的官方 GIS/CAD 文件。触发后需重算 geometry、metrics、figures、PDFs、HTML 和自检，不能仅替换 boundary 文件。
assumptions.statement_en: Official boundary replacement is triggered when the organizer releases an official GIS/CAD file with a verifiable coordinate system. Upon trigger, all geometry, metrics, figures, PDFs, HTML, and self-checks must be recomputed—not just the boundary file.

assumptions.statement_zh: 年度活动体系、开发者社区运营机制和 AI 场景开放运营机制为概念运营方案。实际活动安排、政府审批、资金支持和参与者转化路径需后续专业运营团队确认。
assumptions.statement_en: The annual event system, developer community operation mechanism, and AI scenario open-operation mechanism are conceptual operation plans. Actual event scheduling, government approvals, funding support, and participant conversion pathways require subsequent professional operation team confirmation.
